results.title: This Chinese EV Is Now Made In Europe. More Are Coming
results.snippet:
Leapmotor is far from the only Chinese automaker looking to establish a manufacturing presence in Europe. BYD is building its own massive factory in Hungary, while Xpeng turned to contract manufacturer Magna in Austria. GAC followed Xpeng’s lead, bringing new work to a facility that previously assembled the Fisker Ocean.
